text_block_list.text: Some time after accomplishing the MC rotation――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Now, feast your eyes!
Behold the gates of hell being shattered!!
choice_data_list: Aah!? The fence is broken to pieces again—!

text_block_list.text: (Snap... roll...)

The fence she kicked through hadn't shattered to pieces;
the top half was still hanging on.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. Of course you would notice.
That I have been afflicted by the Naga's deadly venom."
choice_data_list: Could it be you're still tired from the MC rotation?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I deny it. My body has not forsaken me.
However, it is also true that a change is occurring within me...--

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: No... Wait, an MC rotation?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I achieved my dream—and stagnated. If that is so...
Ah! A new thirst! Together with you, I shall gaze beyond the Yasuda-Takarazuka rotation—and see it through!"
choice_data_list: Beyond that... do you mean finding your future dream?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! That's right! I am the possible future... lying beyond the battlefield where I stepped down.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A writer? A painter sounds nice too. An actor wouldn't be bad either!
Now, let's choose! A dream worthy of me!"

A few days later.
I headed to the dining bar to see how her quest for a dream was coming along.
choice_data_list: How's it going? Found a new dream yet?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, let me offer a drink for that answer first.
Think of it as me, served with a detective twist.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"My brilliant partner found the evidence.
...Right on the back of the melody-weaving box.
Heh heh... Told you this much, so you get it now, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The one who committed the crime using piano wire was...
you, the piano tuner!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I have learned what it means for the moon to wane.
What a detective enjoys is fulfillment—
the intoxication of having provided a resolution.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"However, I do not wish to be intoxicated.
—Rather, I wish to intoxicate others, you see."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for the first glass... a Kir, served as a mocktail.
Its meaning is—"Intoxication."

It was a refreshing mocktail, not overly dry.
The sweetness of the cassis really came through...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, here is your next drink.
Savor it. This is the flavor of my DIY craft... of a shopkeeper guiding scrap wood to its reincarnation.”

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, this skull is so cute!
Maybe I'll take one!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Haahahaa! So you appreciate my art, do you?!
—To someone like you, all I can say is, 'Thank you for your purchase!'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: “Now wrap it up, Assistant Manager! Let us spread the flame of my crest, the ‘Mark of Hamlet’!”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, a sudden epiphany struck me.
Something that leaves a physical form cannot capture a fleeting moment...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: An ornament blessed with eternal favor? If ever asked to create such a thing—I surely wouldn't be able to deliver.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, for the second glass, a Bull Shot. Arranged as
a mocktail. Its meaning is—"Unchanging Days."

It's closer to a meal than a mocktail.
To think there could be such a difference in taste and experience...
choice_data_list: Mocktails really have a lot of depth to them.
Mocktails really are surprisingly complex, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Have you peered into the Well of Barhut?!
Yet, you have merely stepped onto the edge of the abyss!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"There are as many recipes as there were aides to Bacchus—
and the twist changes depending on the guest's taste!
Hence, there is always 'a drink meant just for you'!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For instance—Trainer. I shall present to you
the fleeting instant you truly desire!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A non-alcoholic gin base, shaken with apricot syrup and orange juice.
That right there is a paradise painted by Tintoretto...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The sun was unruly tonight, so I added extra gin.
I tailored it for a drier taste. How is it?
choice_data_list: ...It's not too sweet, and it's so delicious!!

text_block_list.text:
"Just the right balance of sweet and sour—leaving behind
a refreshing aftertaste. A cup that truly feels like the start of summer!
As I admired it..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —You have a great look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Not to the god of wine.
Intoxicated by my single glass... by me.
That very expression on your face is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's it. Why did I overlook the
Lighthouse of Alexandria?! Right, I was...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I've decided, Trainer!!
I'm going to create a bar that intoxicates the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is the Spring of Juturna that heals the people,
or perhaps the Rainbow Bridge guiding the way to Asgard!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nectar alone does not make a tavern!
Mere imitation of Bacchus yields no true intoxication!
I shall shatter that conventional wisdom into pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "That is the next fleeting moment I seek!! The El Dorado I must someday reach!!!"
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful dream, I'll be cheering you on!
That's a wonderful dream, I'll be cheering you on!

text_block_list.text:
I told her that, seeing her find a new dream.
...Now, I had something to look forward to: visiting the bar she'd run one day.
choice_data_list: By the way, what's the name of this drink?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ah, I hadn't told you yet, had I?
The name of this mocktail is 'Paradise'—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It means "In the middle of a dream."
